messages.author: 334c7505e0b5cf65
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Question about the MCAR model_INLA/INLAMSM
parts:
Hi,

When the models are implemented using the rgeneric latent effect you cannot, in principle, change the priors of the hyperparameters because the model is implemented as a whole block (i.e., latent effect and priors on the hperparamters). What I mean is that you cannot set a different prior for the standard deviations, rho, etc. other than the ones described in the paper. You could modify the R code in case you need different priors. The priors of the hyperparapermers are described in Section 2 for each model.

Best,

Virgilio
